Name: Clark the Reporter (NPC)
Author: strawhatwem
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/105085328-1784845306.png[/img][/center]
[center]About[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Clark grew up just outside of Pelican Town on his parents' farm. Now, he runs the Pelican Town newspaper, The Pelican, at the Print Shop. He takes his work seriously despite the relatively mundane news that breaks in a small rural town. However, Clark is eager to make a difference through his journalism.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]
Outside of work, you'll find him engaging in photography, creative writing, and making miniature figurines. You can even read some of the articles he writes (check the newspaper box!).[/center]

[center][b][size=3]DISCLAIMER: NOT SUPERMAN[/size][/b][/center]
[center][spoiler]If not already obvious, Clark is my AU of Clark Kent/Superman. My NPC does not have superpowers, he's not a superhero, he's just a regular degular human. 

You do NOT need knowledge of Superman to play this, in my opinion.


I do reference a lot of Clark Kent/Superman details, but there are no elements of being a superhero. I'm not claiming that this is comic-accurate or lore-accurate; it's my AU, and basically I'm just doing whatever I want.


Also, I am not very good at journalistic writing. I tried my best but ehhh the articles are just okay. There's also not many articles, but it's just a small extra thing and not the main focus.[/spoiler]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]

[center][/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/105085328-1784915074.png[/img][/center]
[center][b]Clark the Reporter[/b][/center]
[center][spoiler]Birthday: Summer 18
Age: 27
Eligibility: Bachelor
Loves: Ma's Famous Cocoa, Rhubarb Pie, Complete Breakfast, Topaz 
Dislikes: Spicy Eel, Radioactive Ore and Bar[/spoiler]

[b][size=5]Compat[/size][/b]
Should be compatible with major expansions. Please report any scheduling conflicts due to his house placement, and I'll try to find a workaround. No guarantees. [/center]
[center][/center]
[center]If there are map conflicts with his house, let me know, and I'll make a note here of incompatibilities.[/center]
[center][/center]

[center][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4860?tab=description]Stardew Enhanced - The Town[/url][/b][/center]
[center]Turn off the Town Square and Town Sign config options for that mod to prevent map issues.[/center]
[center][/center]

[center][/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/105085328-1784845410.png[/img][/center]
[center]Features
[quote][i]Marriageable NPC
﻿300+ Lines of Dialogue
15+ Events/Heart Events
[/i][b][i]Readable articles! Click on the red newspaper box in front of the Print Shop[/i][/b]
[i]Seasonal Outfits 
Beach sprites + portraits
Spirit's Eve costume
Festival Visits (Danceable!)
Custom spouse room and patio
Custom house/maps[/i]
[i]Custom quests and Special Orders
All festival attendance
﻿New recipes and unlockable dishes
Custom wedding dialogue and portraits
2 portrait furnitures (one friend and one Spouse portrait)
Custom baby sprites
Custom child sprites[/i][/quote]
[b][size=5]Recommended Mods[/size][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20943][b]Let's Move It[/b][/url]
Solves NPC overlap problems.

[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/boxosoup/mods]boxosoup[/url]﻿[/b]'s[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43723] [b]Birthday[/b][/url]﻿ mod
Clark has special dialogue on the player's birthday.[/center]
[center][/center]

[center][b][size=5]Config Guide[/size][/b][/center]
[quote][center][b]"Hair Type - Girl/Boy"[/b]
Allows you to choose which hair type you'd like for your child. There are two options: Straighter and Coily.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b]"Tilly and Clark Rival Hearts"[/b][/center]
[center]Allows you to enable/disable Rival Hearts content, allowing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38008]Tilly[/url] and Clark to become romantically involved.
[b]THIS CONTENT IS INCOMPLETE. There's only unique festival content for Clark and Tilly at the moment. Some other small things, but really no content.

"Dead Boy Detectives Compat"[/b][/center]
[center]Flip on to fix the map when Tongue 'n Tail (the butcher shop) from DBD is located in Town.[/center]
[/quote][center][b][size=5]
﻿Schedule[/size][/b][/center]
[center]Please use any schedule viewing mod to get full breakdowns. Below are exceptions/special schedules.

[spoiler][left]Spring 16: At the Festival.
Summer 21: Trout Derby
Winter 23: Checkup at the Hospital.
Winter 13: SquidFest
Winter 16: At the Night Market.

Green Rain: Saloon.[/left]
[/spoiler]


[/center]
[center][size=5][b][size=5][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/105085328-1784845444.png[/img][/size][/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=2]Events[/size]﻿[/center]
[quote][b][b]1 Heart[/b][/b]
Enter the Saloon on a Thursday, Friday, or Sunday between 5 PM and 8 PM.

[b]3 Heart
[/b]Enter Clark's Apartment between 7 AM and 8 PM.

[b]4 Heart
[/b]Enter the Museum between 9 AM and 8 PM.

[b]5 Heart Part 1
[/b]Enter Town on a sunny Friday or Saturday between 10 AM and 12 PM. It cannot be winter. 

[b]5 Heart Part 2
[/b]Enter Town after seeing the previous event between 4 PM and 5 PM.

[b]9 Heart Date
[/b]Enter the Beach on a sunny day between 9 AM and 4 PM. Must be dating Clark. It cannot be winter. 

[b]12 Heart Date
[/b]Clark will send you mail after you reach 12 Hearts with him. Enter the Bus Stop on a sunny day between 10 AM and 12 PM. It cannot be winter.

[b]13 Heart Part 1
[/b]Enter the Farmhouse that has been upgraded at least 2 times. Spoiler: Clark will leave/be invisible for 14 days a few days after this event. You will be notified by mail when that happens.

[b]13 Heart Part 2
[/b]Clark returns. Should play the moment you wake up after Clark is visible again. Otherwise, enter the Farmhouse between 6 AM and 5 PM on a sunny day. Must have seen the previous event and have received the corresponding mail.


[b][size=4]STORY ARC[/size][/b]
[spoiler][b]Vincent Gets Sick
[/b]Enter the Hospital between 6 AM and 4 PM. Must have caught a Largemouth Bass already. 

[b]Board 
[/b]Enter the Print Shop between 9 AM and 7 PM. Must have at least 2 Hearts with Clark. At least 5 days must have passed since viewing the previous event. 

[b]Confirming with Demetrius [/b]
Enter the Carpenter's Shop between 9 AM and 8 PM. Must have at least 4 Hearts with Clark. Must have seen the previous event. 

[b]Phone Call[/b]
Enter the Print Shop between 9 AM and 7 PM. Must have at least 5 Hearts with Clark. At least 4 days must have passed since the previous event. The Bus must be repaired. 

[b]Investigation[/b]
Enter the Bus Stop on a sunny day between 6 AM and 8 AM. Must have at least 6 Hearts with Clark. Must have seen the previous event.
*Clark will become invisible for the rest of the day. 

[b]Article Writing[/b]
Enter the Print Shop between 9 AM and 11 PM while Clark is there. Must have at least 7 Hearts with him. Must have seen the previous event. 

[b]Conclusion[/b]
Enter Town on a sunny day between 8 AM and 5 PM. Must have at least 8 Hearts with Clark. Must have seen the previous event.

[b]BBQ[/b]
Enter Town on a sunny Friday or Saturday between 12 PM and 7 PM. It cannot be winter. Must have seen the previous event.[/spoiler]
[/quote][center][b][size=5][size=5]Update Plans[/size][/size]
[/b][i]I'm starting school, so I'll be busy for a very long time. These are just things I want to do if I have the time.

Nyapu-style portraits.
Extra event that I didn't get to with the town kids.[/i][/center]
[center][i]More articles.
Rival Hearts with Tilly.
Platonic route (maybe). You're not missing that much if you don't marry him.[/i]
[/center]

[center][b][size=5][size=5]Translation[/size][/size][/b]
i18n support is available. If you'd like to translate this mod, please ask first!﻿

[b][size=5][size=5]Portraits[/size][/size]
[/b]Feel free to [i]draw[/i] new portraits for Clark. No AI, no NSFW. Feel free to change his style to whatever rendition of Clark Kent you think is best.[/center]
